Definition: from G3844 and G4198; to travel near:--go, pass (by).
BiblicalUsage: Paraporeuomai means to go or pass by, to travel along. In Mark 2:23 Jesus goes through the corn fields on the sabbath, and His disciples begin to pluck the ears of corn. In Matthew 27:39 those who pass by the cross revile Him, wagging their heads.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the same passing by can be a disciple following Jesus through the fields or a crowd mocking Him on the cross, and the difference is whether I stop and look.
